title: Building
description: Sits in a Building Slot. `trains` makes it a production building with its own unit queue; `combat` makes it armed; `techSlots` makes it a Lab.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

extracts.description: Paid at each Payday, times its Planet's Richness for each Resource, rounded down.

refines.title: Refining
refines.description: Converts input into output at each Payday, after Upkeep. Short of input, it converts what there is at the same rate.

techSlots.description: Makes it a Lab, holding this many Techs.

research.description: Research it makes per second in each Research field named, the same on every Planet.

padTurret.description: Can be built on a build pad in Battle, lasting only that Battle. Needs a combat block.
